Each source uses its normal scene seed; these are within-source return-to-rest comparisons, not cross-source pixel identity proof.
strawberry.cause: The unchanged native update caps dt at 0.1 seconds; pulse decay advances in simulation time, while the smoke predicate has a 15-second wall-time budget. Both sources eventually return to rest in the probe. However, the later controlled Mesa comparison passes on main and on the raw candidate, while the compressed candidate fails. An external fixture observer then records both latest main and candidate failing before the pulse completes. The homepage fallback is not a demonstrated fix; the subsequent native-entry commit restores the original HTTP engine globally. This observation diagnoses unfinished simulation time and does not establish a production animation defect or a demonstrated timing fix.
